plan: Deep-copy inputs, resolve exclusions recursively, apply catalog effects, then scale exactly with Fraction.
Validate final equipment and aggregate every impossibility reason deterministically.
mechanisms: Catalog choices are ordered by numeric priority and original catalog position.
Depth-first substitution handles additional ingredients, chained exclusions, and name-based cycle detection.
Deferred scaling applies the target-yield ratio to every original and introduced ingredient.
Equipment and wording changes accumulate in choice order; diagnostics are collected without short-circuiting.
authored_text is never transformed, so print_original returns it byte-for-byte.
